resources.string: Removes tracking from links you copy and paste

Removes tracking junk (like ?s=, si=, utm_ and fbclid) from links automatically. When you copy a link in an app, or paste one into a text box, the clean link replaces it.\n\nIt only looks at \"Copy\" buttons, \"Copied\" notices and text you have just pasted. Surveillance Slop Remover has no internet permission, so nothing can leave your phone.
